verdict.rationale: Stripe's first-party docs state that Checkout lets customers enter payment details on a fully featured page via a redirect to a Stripe-hosted page. The page is built from prebuilt UIs through the Checkout Sessions API, supports 125+ local payment methods, and adapts to the customer's local language and currency, so developers need not build their own payment UI. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of conversion optimization (e.g. tested or optimized layouts, conversion metrics), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the hosted checkout experience.
